# COORD_C622_GUARDED_FAMILY_EXACT_CORE9_V1

Complete exact recovery core for three distinct rational own110/weak000 C622 bodies and one exact C622 nonwinner. This does not improve the edge record and does not replace the canonical VQ20_C622_ROUTE88_118_G12 identity. This core does not depend on the companion numerical-method material; that companion preserves how the finite input checkpoint was found.

## Dependencies and exact identities
Both complete canonical SCOPED16 materials are required:
- [internal-source-reference],15305bytes,SHA256 d5846089dd79e70e4aa35f67d5d66b8480c3dd72bca1de45359a281931f632aa.
- [internal-source-reference],20685bytes,SHA256 c4a0ef05c36066f7b2851dc18ea1c3cda599f724130ec0ce7a89785613cde5b1.
They recover SCOPED16_SOURCE with four unchanged independent exact reconstruction/audit/mass modules and canonical GENERATOR.json. Canonical parent result figure-0373,SHA2568a9f5de8374e75eb2e09766c3546f750afd74102ae1fc3bddef86c4da45dc68d was read completely before this derivation. Its later complete source closure, rather than its originally missing payload, supplies exact input recovery.

The exact body INPUTS/GUARDED_G12.json is a complete finite rational checkpoint, not a request to rerun a floating optimizer. GUARDED_G9 is obtained by exact ties-to-even rounding of all its stored control integers from grid10^12 to10^9. GUARDED_G8M2 uses grid10^8 and then changes mixed-control coordinates(166,2,-1),(174,2,+1). Those are control-node indices, not physical rawlex vertices or support labels. UNGUARDED_L2_G12 is a separate complete exact nonwinner checkpoint. All raw inequalities and vertices are regenerated, not approximated.

All four actual bodies have V176/E311/F137,C622 and all137 support rows active. Each received complete independent exact A and B hull/incidence/own-filled-mass/all-feature/weak checks, identical reports, and separate348-positive-centred-integer-tetrahedron integration with zero first moments and matching volume. The complete four-case cold replay terminal was observed: COORD_C622_GUARDED_FAMILY_AB_MASS_MAP_ESCAPE_PASS. CPython3.13.5,standard library only,assertions enabled. Numerical packages are not used by the exact replay.

The three GUARDED bodies have strict110/weak000,Sinput3,Urawlex94,1244edge primitives and zero primitive degeneracy counters. They have the same owner-labelled maximal complex as canonical, but NOT identical physical rawlex labels: canonical-to-new swaps57/58,64/65,164/165. The complete mapping is regenerated and checked against oriented face cycles and edges. Do not transfer canonical physical labels without this map. The nonwinner has strict(6,7,11),weak000 and is not mechanically acceptable.

Arithmetic and exact escape witnesses:
- COORD_C622_GUARDED_G12: common centred denominator/maxinteger56850bits,primitive support395bits,raw vertex529/533bits; fullpoint escape mu>1/3500000.
- COORD_C622_GUARDED_G9: centred41202bits,support277bits,raw377/378bits; mu>1/4500000.
- COORD_C622_GUARDED_G8M2: centred36033bits,support244bits,raw330/333bits; mu>1/16000000.
- COORD_C622_UNGUARDED_L2_G12_NONWINNER: centred57164bits,support389bits,raw531/532bits; own(6,7,11),no positive escape claim.

Here mu is the minimum over nonroot physical and centred-polar vertices of the largest normalized fullpoint radial escape. Roots are certified separately by the complete feature audits. EXACT_ESCAPE.py uses only integer dot products and squared inequalities with positive signs, not approximate angles. EXACT_CANONICAL_UPPER.py proves that all136 comparisons in canonical centred-polar row63 are <11/10^9, hence canonical mu<11/10^9. Therefore G12/G9/G8M2 improve this specific escape measure over canonical by strict factors2000/77,2000/99,125/22 respectively. These are not manufacturing tolerances, all-feature clearance ratios, or global optima. G8M2 reduces centred bits56802→36033 while increasing this escape measure; it remains C622. The simpler unconditioned COORD_C622_ROUND_G10_OWN110 remains a distinct useful direct-rounding construction.
